title: arc lock — settled prose, refused to every write path
description: A lock says: this prose is settled — work around it. It anchors in one of exactly three shapes (a paragraph with its quote, a scene alone, a chapter alone; A40-1), and may carry an absorption link to the wider lock doing its work (A40-2). These records decide whether the author's settled prose can be overwritten, which is why they are the one kind of committed story state that must not go unchecked.

anchor.description: One of three shapes, never a blend — a chapter anchor naming a paragraph claims two sizes at once, and enforcing either half would be enforcing a guess.

oneOf.description: a paragraph lock — the original shape; the quote is the durable anchor
a section lock — the scene entire, settled; no quote, so it can never drift or orphan
a chapter lock — every scene whose frontmatter names this chapter

absorbed_by.description: the wider lock doing this one's work; while it exists this lock enforces nothing and renders nowhere, and lifting it restores this record exactly
